latency_telemetry.notes: Dominated by unpruned 1,800-token vision prefill + per-step HTTPS download

conclusions: Un-finetuned zero-shot model achieves 52.78% strict in-box accuracy on 557 macOS clicks without any desktop task training.
Near-miss delta between 0.0px and 15.0px is 8.44% (47 samples grazes within 15px of boundary).
Confirms Step 5.4 Stage 1 warmup gate of >= 65.00% is directly reachable via QLoRA fine-tuning.
Validates Phase 5 transition to Step 5.2 (OS-Atlas / ShowUI-desktop + Windows 11 dataset curation).
